"I re-worked more of the combat section. Specifically the combat actions and the conditions in which a character may lose their guard, dodge or delayed action (such as from getting attacked by an enemy). Also re-worded the wrestling and retreat & evasion sections.

I re-structured the line of sight and illumination rules, as well. In a recent play test I did, I gave one character a torch and said that the rest of the room was dark. It made things more strategic to figure out where the torch bearer should stand...but I also realized that light would be blocked by walls and other obstacles; so I made a rule that says if line of sight between the target space and the light source are blocked, light won't illuminate that area. I'm not sure if I want this rule or not: On one hand it's more realistic, but on the other it's going to require LOS checks for both attacker to defender but also torcher bearer to defender.

I also made a stipulation in the rules that says if you can draw a straight line from only one corner of a space to a corner of the target space AND the line has to pass through a "partial cover" space, that the LOS is essentially lost. In otherwords, you're shooting through a narrow passage through another type of "partial cover" making the shot not possible because of it's difficulty.

Anyway, that's about all I have to report for now (besides more grammar corrections).
